common_name: White Out Knock Out Rose (White-Flowered Knock Out)
subcategory: landscape shrub rose, Knock Out series

planting.note: Transplant container-grown plants in spring after the last hard freeze, into well-drained soil with room for the shrub's mature rounded form.

directions: Plant in full sun in well-drained soil, watering deeply during the first season and then only during dry spells once established. White Out bears clean, single white flowers with a small yellow center, opening continuously from spring to frost on this low-maintenance landscape shrub, part of the widely planted Knock Out series bred for disease resistance and repeat bloom without deadheading, since spent flowers drop cleanly on their own. Its compact, rounded, self-cleaning habit suits mass plantings, foundation beds, and low hedges with minimal upkeep. Light shearing in late winter keeps the shrub's form tidy and encourages a fresh, heavy first bloom flush.
